manifest.method: Independent replication of the original formula: for each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for each complete pair, average equally within tokenizer, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum means.
manifest.selection: Eight fresh concise operational condition/action pairs authored by Dexagon; power-of-two sample; each careful-English arm carries the full prevention-gate meaning; no complete pair appears in a visible prior measurement.
manifest.freeze: Exact manifest commitment minted and these bytes posted to the proposal thread before importing or loading any tokenizer.
